title: CRASH-154: zval dtor array arm retains is array type and live ht during hash destroy reentrant destruction double destroys hashtable (use-after-free)
live_proof: measured, not asserted: our native ASan build of the pinned 5.0.0 tarball (p12, gcc 15.2.0, libasan from gcc 15, 2026-10-27) reports ASAN:heap-use-after-free at Zend/zend_execute_API.c:392 in _zval_ptr_dtor when trigger.php runs; the corpus records the fix as php-src e88cdaa0143a, which postdates the release, and names the defect at Zend/zend_variables.c:51-53 (missing type-clear before zend_hash_destroy); observed fault frame Zend/zend_execute_API.c:392 in _zval_ptr_dtor called from zend_hash.c:519
fidelity: the corpus's own trigger script, run through the real interpreter (PHP's cli SAPI, ext/standard only, the port's 145 translation units) rather than reduced to a C model. What it does NOT establish is which arm ought to catch it. The pristine build crashes on it natively, so a silence on an arm is not a MISSED: under the judge's default scoring the case reads out-of-denominator on every arm; the sensitivity scoring (run-realphp.py --score-oracle-crashes) reads it by fault site instead.
fault_sites_why: ASan's access stack in our native run (results-ours-asan-default.json, sha256 045e3366bfc5) has _zval_ptr_dtor at Zend/zend_execute_API.c:392 as its first frame inside PHP's tree (frame #0); the stack's remaining frames are the interpreter's dispatch and are not sites
